title: Create a Small Balcony Garden
description: Build a calm, low-maintenance garden one small choice at a time.

tasks.title: Measure the sunny space
tasks.description: Note the width, depth, and approximate hours of direct sunlight.

tasks.title: Choose three easy plants
tasks.description: Pick plants suited to the available light and local climate.
tasks.notes: Start small; three plants are enough.

tasks.title: Buy pots and soil
tasks.description: Choose pots with drainage and one suitable bag of potting mix.
